create.name: Peter Bolland
create.bio:
Peter Bolland is a San Diego philosophy professor, writer and singer-songwriter who teaches world religions, Asian philosophy and mythology. The son of Dutch immigrants, he grew up in Ventura, California, studied religious studies at UC Santa Barbara and took a master's in philosophy at San Diego State. He began teaching at Southwestern College in 1991 and has been a full-time professor there since 2001, offering courses in world religions, Asian thought, mythology and ethics.

Outside the college he gives talks and short courses around San Diego, at lifelong-learning programmes such as UC San Diego's Osher Institute and Oasis, at the city's Vedanta monastery and at progressive churches and spiritual centres, where he is often a Sunday speaker. His subjects range from the great philosophers to sacred archetypes in myth. He describes his own path as free-range, drawing on many traditions, and he leads beginner-friendly guided meditations that are free on Insight Timer. His book The Seven Stone Path, fourteen years in the writing, explores what wisdom is and why it matters, and he offers a free workbook for readers and study groups. He has also written columns on philosophy and world spirituality and records Americana music.

courses.title: The Great Philosophers: Jean-Paul Sartre
courses.description: A two-hour talk on Sartre's existentialism for UC San Diego's Osher Lifelong Learning Institute in La Jolla, part of his series on major thinkers.

courses.title: The Great Philosophers: Albert Camus
courses.description: A two-hour session at UC San Diego's Osher Lifelong Learning Institute on Camus and his response to the absurd, continuing the same series.

free_resources.title: Peter Bolland on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided meditations on the Insight Timer app, in thirty- and fifteen-minute lengths aimed at beginners.

free_resources.title: The Seven Stone Path Workbook
free_resources.description: A free PDF companion to his book on wisdom, for personal study or for running a book club or discussion group.
